name: codex-with-chatgpt
title_zh: ChatGPT 当军师、Codex 当执行
tagline_zh: 你喊一声“用 ChatGPT 规划”，它就把网页版 ChatGPT 接进当前工作区，让 GPT 拆步骤。
tagline_en: Say "plan with ChatGPT" and it wires web ChatGPT into your workspace—GPT decomposes, Codex edits, no tab switching.
desc_en: Use ChatGPT (web) as the planning and review brain for Codex coding sessions, while Codex keeps full execution ownership. Use when the user says "使用 Codex with ChatGPT ..." / "Set up Codex with ChatGPT" / "用 ChatGPT 规划", when they ask to connect ChatGPT to the current workspace, disconnect it, or run a task through the ChatGPT planning loop.
why_zh: 不是简单转发提示词，而是让 ChatGPT 做规划与审查、Codex 保留完整执行权。
why_en: Not a prompt relay—it gives ChatGPT planning/review while Codex keeps execution, in a disconnectable two-way loop that tames big.
limit_zh: 需要你本机已装 Codex CLI 且能登录网页版 ChatGPT；只覆盖 ChatGPT 网页端，不接 API。
limit_en: Requires local Codex CLI and logged-in web ChatGPT; web only, no API. Disconnecting drops planning context—you must rebuild it.
title_en: ChatGPT plans, Codex executes: a coding loop that finishes
